prior_counterexample.description: The former ERR trap handler disabled errexit with set +e and returned success after recovery. Bash therefore resumed after the failed smoke and printed a false PASS.
prior_counterexample.semantic_probe_command: wsl.exe -e bash -c "set -Eeuo pipefail; rollback(){ trap - ERR; set +e; echo ROLLBACK; true; }; smoke(){ false; echo SMOKE_CONTINUED; }; trap rollback ERR; smoke; trap - ERR; echo SWITCH_STATUS=PASS"
prior_counterexample.material_impact: A failed switch or manual rollback could restore the previous release yet continue and emit a success marker.

resolution.change: rollback and manual_recover capture the incoming status in failure_status, disable recursive ERR handling only for recovery, and terminate the shell with exit failure_status on every recovery outcome.
resolution.durable_regression: scripts/nwg-deployment-contract.test.mjs executes the extracted automatic-switch rollback function with an injected restart failure and requires nonzero exit, absence of SWITCH_STATUS=PASS, and restoration of the old SHA target.
resolution.result: The prior false-PASS counterexample does not apply to the target implementation.

minor.title: Sequential child cleanup can short-circuit
minor.detail: runCanonicalIntegration awaits gateway stop, static stop, and temporary cleanup sequentially; an exceptional first stop can skip later cleanup. This is confined to the test harness and does not target the live release tree.

minor.title: Dynamic-port release and rebind has a TOCTOU window
minor.detail: The helper asks the OS for a loopback port, closes the reservation, and then launches the child. A competing process can acquire the port in between; failures remain bounded to the temporary integration run.

minor.title: Credential metadata is documented but not rechecked by the switch preflight
minor.detail: The runbook records root:root mode 0600, while the switch recipe checks readability rather than asserting owner, group, and mode with stat.
